verdict.rationale: Docs promise a self-serve quickstart ('make your first API call in under a minute') and a free tier with 'generous limits' before scaling to paid usage, with no mention of sales calls or waitlists (gemini-docs-19, gemini-docs-14). However, hands-on community reports contradict the frictionless framing: users describe needing $250+ prior Google Cloud spend and a 30-day-old account just to exceed a 250-requests/day Tier 1 cap, describe 'a whole different set of friction' versus OpenAI/Anthropic, and had to 'warm up' a project for weeks to reach usable quotas (gemini-comm-1, gemini-comm-2, gemini-comm-4), even though one commenter credits Google for the free-tier key itself (gemini-comm-3). Missing for 10: first-party documentation explicitly walking through the tiered eligibility gymnastics (cloud spend/age requirements) that community evidence shows exists in practice, and independent confirmation that initial key minting itself (not scaling) is frictionless.
